cases.customer_question: Is it necessary to send a modification memo (改造メモ) when proceeding with Bluetooth SIG certification support?
question_variants: Do we need to provide a modification memo for Bluetooth qualification?
Is the 改造メモ required during SIG certification support?
Should the modification document be sent to the customer for qualification?
What documents must be sent at the start of Bluetooth certification?
Is the modification memo mandatory for registration support?
cases.actual_issue: Clarifying whether a modification memo is a required document in the Bluetooth qualification support process and when it should be provided.
cases.plain_english_explanation: The team is unsure whether they need to send a document that describes modifications (改造メモ) to the customer during the certification process. This document is part of the standard process but may be overlooked. The question is about whether it is mandatory and when it should be sent.
cases.consultant_answer: The modification memo is required and must be sent. It should be provided as part of the standard process, ideally at the time of order intake. Additionally, the registration information confirmation form should also be sent and collected together with it.
cases.decision_logic: If the process includes qualification support and registration handling, required administrative documents such as the modification memo and registration confirmation form must be collected. These are standard deliverables tied to the qualification workflow.
cases.final_recommendation: Send the modification memo and request submission from the customer. Also include the registration information confirmation form at the same time.
cases.risk_if_done_wrong: Missing required documents can delay the qualification process or block submission due to incomplete administrative documentation.
